purpose: Map a frozen as-of evidence report and its source records into the claim-scoped provenance and temporal fields of an FSRE v0.2 claim envelope. This is a mapping contract, not source authentication or an automatic claim-status promotion.

timestamp_conversion.rule: Convert Unix seconds to an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp without changing the instant. Reject a different input clock basis; do not infer timezone or offset.

claim_level_mappings.rule: Must match the claim scope exactly; otherwise reject the envelope mapping.
Convert from Unix seconds using timestamp_conversion.
Copy the effective maximum age used for this claim.
Map to SUPPORTED_AS_KNOWN_AT_CUTOFF; do not automatically promote claim_status.
Map to NOT_ESTIMABLE; overall claim_status should remain INDETERMINATE unless the wider claim assessment establishes another status.
Must remain false; reject any report that indicates future information was used.
Use the exact evaluator identity/revision that produced the report.

claim_level_mappings.source: frozen report or source report location
claim_level_mappings.rule: Use a stable repository/object reference and digest where the surrounding envelope supports it.

source_frontier_mappings.rule: Preserve owner; never infer owner from a URI or evaluator.
Preserve opaque owner-native source reference; do not replace it with a copied record.
Convert using timestamp_conversion; this is decision-process availability, not necessarily database transaction time.
Convert using timestamp_conversion when the source reports revocation.
Convert using timestamp_conversion; distinguishes later knowledge from earlier world-time effect.
Use the source owner's schema version.
Copy only an owner/source-produced digest; never invent one.

non_inference_rules: as_of_admissibility is not source_authenticity and must not be copied into provenance.source_frontier[].admissibility.
An admissible-as-known record is not proof that the source statement is physically true.
Do not infer independent sources from distinct record IDs or source references.
Do not map as-of claim disposition directly to root claim_status without assessing the claim's other evidence, adequacy, independence and claim ceiling.
Do not use a future-discovered revocation to rewrite the historical as-known disposition; preserve both as-of and hindsight fields.

The as-of evidence evaluator v0.1 compares exact UTC-second timestamps and does not model non-zero clock uncertainty. Use clock_uncertainty_handling=EXACT_TIMESTAMP_ASSUMED only when zero uncertainty is justified; use OWNER_BOUNDED_NOT_EVALUATED or BOUNDARY_SENSITIVE_UNRESOLVED otherwise and do not claim boundary qualification.
Do not promote the result into operational authority, dispatch permission or actuation.

versioning.note: A future source report/schema or claim-envelope schema version requires an explicit crosswalk revision and replay; do not silently reuse this mapping.
